projects.title: Website Monitoring Control Panel
projects.summary: A real-time platform that monitors website availability and service health using layered checks, with a live dashboard and incident alerts.
projects.problem: The team needed one central place to see whether websites and services were healthy, instead of checking each one manually.
projects.solution: I built a monitoring platform that runs scheduled DNS, ICMP, TCP, TLS/SSL and HTTP checks in the background, stores the results in PostgreSQL, and pushes status changes to a React dashboard over WebSocket.
projects.outcome: The team gets a single dashboard showing service status in real time, Telegram alerts when a site goes down or recovers, and a weekly uptime report by email.
features: Anti-flapping: 3 failed samples before marking down
Telegram alerts for downtime and recovery
Daily aggregates for uptime / SLA reports
contributions: Built backend monitoring services in Go (chi router) with REST endpoints for websites, logs, incidents, users and dashboard data.
Implemented scheduled background health checks using per-site tickers and a goroutine worker pool.
Implemented WebSocket-based real-time status updates to the dashboard.
Stored check results, status events and incidents in PostgreSQL, managed with versioned SQL migrations.
Built the React dashboard for operational visibility: status panels, response-time graphs and a topology view.
Integrated Telegram and email notification workflows, with anti-flapping to avoid false alarms.
Added JWT authentication with role-based access and exposed Prometheus metrics from the backend.
Wrote Go unit tests for status classification and notification formatting.

projects.title: IoT Coffee Fermentation Monitoring & Control System
projects.role: Thesis team member — device firmware, sensor testing
projects.summary: An IoT system that monitors and controls coffee fermentation using an ESP32, environmental sensors, actuators, MQTT communication and a mobile app.
projects.problem: Coffee fermentation depends on keeping temperature, humidity and pH in the right range. Checking it by hand is slow and easy to get wrong.
projects.solution: An ESP32-based device reads temperature, humidity and pH, switches a heater lamp, fan, humidifier and solenoid valve through relays, and publishes data over MQTT. Node-RED stores the data in InfluxDB and MySQL, and a Flutter app shows it and sends control commands back.
projects.outcome: A working prototype tested in the thesis: sensors were checked against reference instruments, and fermentation sessions could be started, monitored and stopped from the mobile app.
features: Automated control based on target conditions
Data logging to InfluxDB and MySQL
Real-time charts in the app and Grafana
RTC timestamps and LCD status display
contributions: Worked on the ESP32 firmware: reading sensors, driving relays and publishing data over MQTT.
Tested and calibrated the pH and temperature / humidity sensors against reference instruments.
Helped integrate the device with the MQTT broker, Node-RED and the mobile app.
Contributed to the Flutter app for real-time monitoring and control.

projects.title: Lucky Mart – Grocery Ordering Platform
projects.summary: A full-stack ordering platform I'm building for my parents' grocery store, covering products, inventory, cart, checkout, orders, shipping, payments and customer credit.
projects.problem: My parents run a grocery store. Orders, stock and customers who buy on credit are tracked by hand. I started Lucky Mart to bring that into one system, and to apply what I learned at Institut Teknologi Del to a real need.
projects.solution: A Go (Gin) REST API with a layered structure (handlers → services → repositories with GORM) on PostgreSQL, used by two React + TypeScript apps: a customer web store and an admin dashboard for the store. Local services run with Docker Compose.
projects.outcome: The backend core and 80+ REST endpoints are in place, and both frontends are being finished. Next step: preparing it for hosting so the store can actually use it.
features: JWT auth with access and refresh tokens
contributions: Designed the database models and the layered Go backend.
Built REST endpoints for products, cart, orders, payments, shipping and customer credit.
Building a customer web store and an admin dashboard (inventory, stock movements, orders, payments, credit ledger) in React + TypeScript.
Set up Docker Compose for PostgreSQL, the backend and supporting services.
Work in progress: GitHub Actions CI workflow, Prometheus / Grafana config and k6 load-test script.
